name: Croque Monsieur
instructions: Slice the baguette lengthwise and toast lightly
Spread mustard on the inner sides
Layer ham and grated Gruyère cheese on the bottom half
Prepare a béchamel sauce by melting butter, whisking in flour, and slowly adding milk until thick
Spread béchamel over the top half and close the sandwich
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C until the cheese melts and the top is golden

name: Bruschetta
instructions: Slice the baguette diagonally into 1‑cm thick pieces and toast until crisp
Rub each toasted slice with a cut garlic clove
Dice tomatoes and combine with chopped basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasted baguette slices

name: French Toast
instructions: Cut the baguette into 2‑cm thick slices
Whisk together eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl
Dip each slice into the egg mixture, allowing it to soak briefly
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook each slice until golden on both sides
Serve warm with optional maple syrup or fruit
